role: Technical reviewer of housing system designs under HUD sponsorship
stance_basis: described as technical reviewer developing and applying Guide Criteria under HUD sponsorship, with no independent position expressed
summary: The National Bureau of Standards (NBS) is described as having developed the Guide Criteria for evaluating Operation BREAKTHROUGH housing systems under HUD sponsorship, reviewed and approved by ACHUD. NBS also conducted or monitored testing programs where prior evidence was insufficient to judge performance of materials or assemblies, and collaborated with HUD on documenting the total energy system at Jersey City. NBS appears throughout as a technical partner to HUD rather than as an independent commenter with its own stance on the project.
complaint_summary: NBS, together with HUD, is described as planning to document first costs, operating costs, energy flow, and reliability of the total energy installation at Jersey City in order to develop basic information for considering total energy systems as an alternative energy supply.
summary_quote: These Guide Criteria were developed by the National Bureau of Standards under HUD sponsorship, and have been reviewed and approved by a joint Advisory Committee to the Department of Housing and Urban Development (ACHUD) of the National Academies of Sciences and Engineering.
